elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Client expressly owns “all deliverables and work product created for Client under this Agreement.”

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink expressly assigns “all right, title and interest therein” to Client.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: TrueLink retains its ownership rights in the Interface, and embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property is licensed rather than assigned; the assignment is limited to deliverables and work product created for Client.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The license to TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in the deliverables and work product is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property license is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property license is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Client retains all right, title and interest in Client Content and all borrower and loan data, the identified categories of Client data.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states: “No intellectual property will be jointly owned by the parties.”

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: TrueLink retains the Interface and embedded TrueLink IP, but the clause does not reserve generic tools and know-how generally, including any created as part of the work product.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Client receives outright ownership of the deliverables without a time limit, and the license covering embedded TrueLink IP is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Client receives an outright assignment of the deliverables, and the license covering embedded TrueLink IP is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Neither the assignment nor the embedded-IP license expressly provides worldwide rights, and the embedded-IP license contains no stated territorial scope.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the license needed for embedded TrueLink IP is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Although ownership supports use of the deliverables, the license to embedded TrueLink IP does not expressly permit modification, so modification of the complete deliverables is not assured.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The license to embedded TrueLink IP contains no sublicensing right, so Client cannot clearly sublicense the complete deliverables.
